Use case: collectible card illustration with storybook quality. Create ONE finished narrative scene, landscape1536×1024 PNG, opaque full-bleed from edge to edge. This is the FRONT CARD ILLUSTRATION only, without a frame, writing, UI or panels.
Reference1 defines the exact clean angular faceted character art style. Reference2 defines the warrior race: ginger-orange striped fur, cream muzzle/inner ears, dark brown paws, chunky golden armor and crimson cloth. Match their expressive big heads, short sturdy bodies and simple shapes. Do not copy either reference's standing or attacking pose.
CARD: Shield Cat / 방패냥. MOMENT: immediately after rain on a quiet battlefield, a dependable little warrior has nodded off while leaning against a huge rectangular shield studded with several arrows. The shield has caught every arrow and protects its owner. The cat's cheek rests on its upper rim, eyelids comfortably closed, shoulders drooping, seated with small paws relaxed; weight and sleepy pose must be instantly clear. Behind the sleeper, one smaller fellow ginger warrior in gold armor and crimson cloth looks at them with an incredulous raised eyebrow and folded forepaws, like 'Really, now?' No speech bubbles or sleep letters. Gentle visual comedy, no injury, blood, corpses or distress. Clear facial expression, believable shield contact, separate ears and props. The shield is tall, broad and square/rectangular with a straight flat top, a dark reddish-brown wooden face and broad faceted gold rim, a few bold readable arrow shafts lodged in its front at varied angles. Do NOT replace this with the round shield in the references.
COMPOSITION: moderately low three-quarter view, intimate and story-driven, not a standing unit token. Main sleeping cat slightly right of center, its face around x58% y42%; shield around x50% y60%. Secondary companion behind at x76% y40%, smaller and subordinate. Keep the ENTIRE main head/ears, paws, shield, arrow tips and companion's face inside x24%–84% and y18%–83%. The central70% contains all storytelling. The top7% and bottom7% are expendable background only: no face, ears, paws, arrow tips or important props in those strips. Cropping about7% from both top and bottom must preserve the whole story and protagonist. Keep the upper-left fifth visually quiet for a cost overlay: cool plain far sky and distant low battlefield shapes, no characters, arrows or focal highlights there. Full scene continues outside the safe area naturally.
TIME AND MOOD: clearing late-afternoon rain. A single warm light from UPPER LEFT catches the sleepy ginger face and gold rim against a cool slate-blue/lavender cloud bank. A small flat puddle catches one simple warm stepped reflection, no painted shine. Quiet rolling field in the distance, one or two distant bent standards with no emblems or lettering, distant shapes pale and simplified. Dark flat grass and a broken branch silhouette frame only the extreme lower left and lower right, do not cover the faces or shield. Depth uses clear overlapping flat planes and pale far silhouettes. Limit scene to3–4 major hue families: cool slate blue, warm gold, orange fur, crimson cloth. No photographic rendering, physical texture, brushes, haze blur or light bloom. Atmosphere, puddle reflections and clouds use hard-edged2–3 tone stepped planes. Large intentional shapes, restrained details, strong visual story at300px width. No text, letters, numerals, signature, watermark, borders, tiny decorations or UI.
Clean indie flat vector illustration matching the style reference warrior exactly: angular faceted planes with straight hard edges, like folded paper or cut gems, two to four tones per material, single light source from the upper left. Bold dramatic silhouette, same body proportions and exaggeration as the reference. No rounded blobby shapes, no gradients, no texture, no grain, no noise, no glow, no blur, no black outlines. Crisp clean edges, opaque full-bleed background. Simple eyes like the reference with one clear white highlight at the upper left (only the awake companion; the sleeping cat's eyes are closed). Smallest details at least10 px wide.
